summary: Implemented the philosophy feature extraction structure with registry, checker, CLI command, tests, agent spec, prompt/workflow, traceability/memory links, and Workspace Monitor panel. Final validation passed across config contracts, philosophy feature/trace checks, memory bootstrap, omission/grounding/evaluator, Python unittest, Workspace Monitor test/check/build, customer build, performance budget, customer snapshot sanitization, and customer output keyword scans.

acceptance.evidence: `check-philosophy-features` returned ready with 18 required principles covered by flows.

acceptance.criterion: Future sessions can discover the structure.
Workspace Monitor exposes the feature factory.
acceptance.evidence: `npm --prefix workspace-monitor test` and `npm --prefix workspace-monitor run check` passed.

acceptance.criterion: Customer bundle does not expose internal philosophy feature candidates.
acceptance.evidence: Customer snapshot reports `philosophyFeatureCandidates=0`, candidates 0, sourcePath empty; internal-path keyword scan found no matches.

residual_risks: Queued candidates are intentionally recorded as future implementation ideas, not shipped features.
Playwright browser smoke was not available because the local package was not installed; static server, curl snapshot, and bundle token scans were used instead.
